applied: [BLOCKER] CMakeLists.txt: test_file_diff and test_transcript are the only targets that compile src/ui/ConversationView.cpp directly (checked with grep). src/ui/Icons.cpp and src/ui/Icons.h are now added to both through the existing transcript_target foreach/target_sources block. Icons.cpp needs only QPainter, so nothing else is required.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindowHistory.cpp: the status label and the side-pane error are now cleared BEFORE engine->retryFailedTurn. Errors reported synchronously during the start therefore stay visible. On success the code only refreshes the side chat or calls renderConversation.

[minor] src/core/AgentEngineHistory.cpp: retryFailedTurn first checks the busy state and the failure/userRowId while idle. It then calls reconcileMutationHistory() under a QPointer guard, checks again for busy, committing-queue or compressing, re-validates the failure, and only then computes lastUserIndex and the unsettled-suffix check. New test tests/test_history_retry.cpp journalSettledSuffixMutationIsReconciledBeforeRetry: a queue committer plus setMutationContext('agent-1', recovery). The external mutation is registered but never settled and the turn fails. Step 1: the journal is empty, the recovery callback receives the invocation, and Retry still refuses with 'still being recorded' and leaves history unchanged. Step 2: the journal returns the committed row. Retry calls recovery, is accepted and dispatches request 4. Without the fix step 2 refuses, because nothing calls reconcile while idle.

[minor] tests/test_history_retry.cpp failureRecordFitsShapeForMultibyteError: the emoji case is replaced with an input of exactly 2000 characters ('a' + 750 emoji + an escaped \u0001 tail, about 5995 JSON bytes), which forces make() to shrink. The first cut (1500) falls between the halves of the pair at 1499..1500. The test checks that the shape is valid, that the result is shorter than the input, that it equals exactly pair.left(1499) (so it fails if the high-surrogate guard is removed), and that no unpaired surrogate appears anywhere. The same check found that make()'s initial error.left(2000) could split a pair. src/core/TurnFailure.h now chops a trailing high surrogate after that bound, and a second case (1999 'b' + emoji) asserts it.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindowControl.cpp: the queuedMessagesChanged handler now calls pushHistoryActions(id, m_transcript) for the current chat and pushHistoryActions(id, pane->transcript()) for an open side pane, with a self check after each call. It now includes SideChatPane.h. tests/test_history_actions_host.cpp queueNoteAndAtomicClear now sets the idle queue to 2 messages and back to 1 through setQueuedMessages, and checks that #transcriptRetryQueueNote follows ('2 queued messages', then '1 queued message.'). No other queuedMessagesChanged listener re-renders the transcript, so the test fails without the fix.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindowHistory.cpp: after the final find(id), the selection, workspace and alwaysAllow are copied into locals and the session pointer is set to null. A self/engine check follows each engine setter (setModelChain, setWorkspace, setAlwaysAllow). Before host->setWorkspace the code calls find(id) again with an archived check.
deviationsToRecord: Retry gives the rebuilt user row a fresh display-envelope ID. Upstream reuses the message ID, so the native projection identity differs from upstream after a Retry (this was already recorded in the slice).
Before refusing Retry over unsettled suffix file mutations, Retry reconciles mutation history from the journal. This uses the native mutation journal, which has no direct upstream equivalent.

TurnFailure records are bounded to 2000 characters and 4096 compact JSON bytes. The error text is truncated without splitting surrogate pairs. This is a native persistence constraint, not an upstream behaviour.
Retry dispatches with the chat's saved model selection, workspace and always-allow, never with unsent composer choices. Upstream reads the live composer and agent state.
The Retry card shows a native note about queued messages and clears the queue atomically together with the history replacement (CommitKind::ReplaceAndAcceptUser).

applied: [minor] tests/test_side_chat_host.cpp ctrlCInSideChatTargetsSideChat: the test is now data-driven (parent-idle / parent-busy). The window-fallback press now goes to sideChatChangesButton (a QToolButton that accepts focus), and the test asserts QApplication::focusWidget() before every Ctrl+C. In the parent-busy row the parent turn is started with submitPrompt and must still be busy after each side-chat stop. Collapsing the content then makes the main composer's Ctrl+C stop the parent. The test also asserts the stop shortcut's activated spy count is 1.

[minor] tests/test_navigation_shortcuts.cpp newShortcutsAreSuppressedInSettingsAndModalDialogs: the test now seeds a discovered harness catalog and selects the direct harness model. It starts a busy engine against a local QTcpServer that never answers, and sets browsing.newTabUrl to https://example.test/page so the context selector is not excluded. It fires every shortcut in Settings and in a modal and asserts that agent.modelThinkingOverrides stays empty, the tabs are unchanged, select is not clicked and the engine is still busy. It also asserts the stop shortcut is disabled in Settings and re-enabled after Back. Positive controls afterwards show that cycle writes 'medium', the context selector clicks once and stop cancels the engine.

[minor] tests/test_image_preview.cpp centerShortcutRefitsAfterManualZoom: the test now zooms in three times and scrolls to the top-left corner. It asserts the scene center is drawn more than 10 viewport px from the viewport center, and after Ctrl+Alt+C it asserts (QTRY) that the distance is at most 1px, on top of the existing scale and label checks.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindowShortcuts.cpp S7: a storage failure now shows m_settings->storageError() when it is not empty, otherwise 'Reasoning effort could not be saved.'. The validation failure now says 'Reasoning effort could not be saved for this model.'

[minor] src/ui/ModelThinking.h: removed withThinkingOverride from the header and from ModelSelection.cpp, and removed its one test assertion. thinkingOverrideValue checks for a preset, and the preset chain test still covers that case.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindow.cpp S3a: removed the direct composer-to-m_stop connection. MainWindowShortcuts.cpp now connects Composer::stopShortcutRequested to the same stopTarget() resolver as S3b, so a visible side-chat tab is stopped instead of the main agent. test_side_chat_host covers this; without the change, the parent-busy row fails because the parent would be cancelled.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindowShortcuts.cpp refreshStop: it now computes enabled() && target enabled, and it also refreshes on m_pages currentChanged and on QApplication::focusChanged, so the state is re-checked when a modal opens or closes. All stop hooks now use the shortcut as their connection context, and ~MainWindow deletes shortcut_stop_agent, which deletes its EnabledChangeWatcher and disconnects every hook, right after the agent cycle controller and before any teardown.

[minor] src/ui/MainWindowShortcuts.cpp toggle_context_selector: it now skips about: pages. Native has no stagewise://internal/ scheme. Its internal new tab is about:blank (addBrowserTab's default, and the only about: URL BrowserSessionStore::restorableUrl keeps). selectBrowserElement is enabled there once the view is ready (MainWindowBrowserTools.cpp updateEnabled checks only isReady and inspector busy), so an explicit exclusion was needed. The URL comes from BrowserWidget::currentUrl(), or from the tab's browserSessionUrl when the view has not reported one yet. The positive test now opens https://example.test/page through browsing.newTabUrl. A new test, contextSelectorIgnoresInternalNewTabPage, fails without the exclusion.
deviationsToRecord: stop_agent S3b: the shortcut's enabled state is stored and refreshed on tab, splitter, page, focus and stop-button enable changes. A popup (QMenu) that closes without a focus change does not trigger a refresh. If a stop target became enabled while that popup was open, the shortcut can stay disabled until the next focus, tab or enable change. The composer path (S3a) is not affected. Upstream evaluates the condition at key time.

stop_agent S3a: native routes the main composer's Ctrl+C through stopTarget(), which matches upstream isActiveChatSurface. The side-chat composer still always stops its own side chat. Ctrl+C from the source editor (CodeEditor) does not stop the agent; upstream stops from Monaco.

toggle_context_selector: native treats about: URLs (the about:blank new tab) as the equivalent of upstream stagewise://internal/. A custom browsing.newTabUrl web page counts as a normal browsing tab. The shortcut is still not reachable from WebView2 content (no accelerator forwarding).

cycle_model_thinking_effort: only efforts discovered from an external harness are cycled. The upstream API-provider thinking capability table is not ported, so HTTP providers and presets have no options.

All 7 changed .cpp files pass syntax-check.py; the only warnings are the existing setActiveWindow deprecation warnings. LF line endings are preserved.

- src/ui/MainWindow.cpp

- tests/test_side_chat_host.cpp

What changed:
- **Stop routing:** the main composer's Ctrl+C now stops the active chat surface, so a visible side-chat tab is stopped instead of the main agent.
- **Stop shortcut state:** the shortcut's enabled state now includes enabled() and refreshes on page and focus changes. ~MainWindow deletes it early, together with its watcher and hooks.
- **Context selector:** Ctrl+I now skips the about:blank new tab, the native equivalent of upstream's stagewise://internal/ pages.
- **Reasoning effort messages:** a storage failure shows SettingsPage::storageError() when set, and the validation message is now neutral.
- **withThinkingOverride:** removed.
- **Tests:** strengthened so each would fail if the guarded code were removed, plus one new test for Ctrl+I on the new-tab page.

The SettingsPage modelThinkingOverrides default validation is untouched, as instructed. No findings were rejected.

applied: [minor] MainWindowRuntime handleInstanceRequest re-shows a window after an accepted close: closeEvent now sets m_closeAccepted (terminal), alongside the existing m_sessionTransition, and clears queued URLs. handleInstanceRequest and URL opening return early without show/raise/alert. The transition test asserts QVERIFY(!window.isVisible()) after close, after a late request and after openStartupUrls.

[minor] InstanceCoordinator replies ok but URLs are dropped during a recovery dialog or transition: MainWindow now queues them in m_pendingInstanceUrls (capped at 8x16) and sets a status message. They open once the self-deleting recovery dialog is destroyed (singleShot after destroyed, so a close chosen in the dialog runs first and drops them) or after a transient transition (retried every 100 ms). recoveryDialogIsRaised now checks the status text and that the tab opens after reject().

[minor] test_agent_activity realEngineAwaitingApprovalIsIdle passed trivially: the fixture now holds request 1 and releases it on demand. A QSignalSpy on activeCountChanged proves the sequence [1] while streaming, [1,0] after approvalRequired, [1,0,1] after approveTool and [1,0,1,0] after cancel. Without isAwaitingUser in the snapshot the 0 step never appears.

[minor] MainWindow.h m_soundOutput destroyed before the child NotificationSoundService that holds a raw pointer to it: ~MainWindow now runs delete m_sounds.data() after stopping output. m_sounds and m_activity are QPointer, and initializeRuntimeEffects connects through a local raw pointer.

[minor] NotificationSounds applyPreferences re-enumerated packs on every save: configure() caches the requested id in m_requestedPack and calls resolvePack only when agent.notificationSound changes. A successful import (commit) invalidates the cache. A new test covers caching, re-resolution on change, and invalidation by import.

[minor] InstanceCoordinator acquire exits 4 on non-LockFailed lock errors: it now logs a qWarning, sets the error text and returns Role::Primary uncoordinated (isPrimary() stays false, no server). This matches the listen-failure policy. A new setLockFunction test seam was added, plus the test lockErrorContinuesUncoordinated.
[minor] becomePrimary stale sidecar: QFile::remove(sidecarPath()) runs right after taking the lock, before listening. listenFailureStillPrimary now pre-seeds a stale sidecar and asserts it is gone.

[minor] AgentEngine isAwaitingUser stale m_harnessApprovals: Codex finish() settles pending approvals itself (settleInputs) before the engine's complete(), and complete() did not clear the map. complete() now clears m_harnessApprovals. Answer, Claude cancel, fail and cancel already removed entries. New HarnessFixture scenario approval-settled plus test_codex_engine serverSettledApprovalDoesNotOutliveTurn, which asserts !isAwaitingUser() after a turn the server completed while the approval was pending.

[minor] CMakeLists system effects for real-platform hosts: a final block appends ADE_DISABLE_SYSTEM_EFFECTS=1 to the ENVIRONMENT of every test registered in the top-level directory (get_property DIRECTORY TESTS + set_property APPEND). This covers native_browser_history_followups, native_transcript_tabs_real, native_mini_app_findings, native_browser_output and native_hidden_browser (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=windows), plus the many MainWindow hosts that inherit the platform with no ENVIRONMENT. The block must stay last.

[minor] main.cpp startup URLs went through the alert path: new MainWindow::openStartupUrls goes through the same queue/open path with no show, activation or QApplication::alert. New test startupUrlsOpenWithoutActivation shows the window stays minimized while the tab opens.

[minor] main.cpp exclusive launch refused on the first failed tryLock while the primary is closing: acquire(refuseIfRunning) now sends a non-activating {v:1,type:probe} frame. The primary answers ok, or closing when it is closing, and never buffers or emits. ok gives Refused. closing, no sidecar or no answer retry until the deadline, then Refused. Lock handover gives Primary. AllowSetForegroundWindow is skipped for probes. Tests: refusesExclusiveLaunchWhileRunning (fast refusal, no requestReceived, deadline refusal) and exclusiveLaunchWaitsForClosingPrimary.
deviationsToRecord: Single-instance wire protocol (ADE-specific, no upstream counterpart in this form): new 'probe' request type {v:1,type:probe} -> {ok:true} | {ok:false,reason:closing}, used only by exclusive launches (--prompt/--import-keys/--workspace). Those launches still exit 3 when a live primary answers, and wait up to 5 s for a closing primary.

Lock-file errors other than 'held by another instance' now start ADE uncoordinated (warning logged, no single-instance server) instead of exiting 4. Exit 4 remains only for 'lock held but the owner never answered'.

URLs forwarded during a session-recovery dialog or transient transition are queued (max 128) and opened after the decision. Upstream has no equivalent recovery dialog. URLs arriving after an accepted close are dropped and the window is not re-shown.

NotificationSoundService resolves the selected pack only when agent.notificationSound changes or after an import. A pack folder deleted outside ADE stays selected (and stays silent for its events) until the preference changes, whereas re-enumeration on every save previously fell back to the default pack.

AgentEngine::complete() clears harness approval entries; isAwaitingUser() stays map-based (approved/cancelled/turn-ended), not upstream's 'latest assistant message has an approval-requested part'. The two are equivalent while consumeHarnessEvent forces approval-requested for mapped keys. Mid-turn, an approval the harness resolves without a terminal event still counts as awaiting until the turn ends, because no harness session reports such a resolution today. Clearing on terminal tool events was rejected: ACP keeps the JSON-RPC request pending and would hang the turn with no way to answer.

CTest: ADE_DISABLE_SYSTEM_EFFECTS=1 is appended to every test in the top-level CMakeLists by a final block. Tests registered after that block (by later slices) would not receive it unless the block stays last.
Carried over from the slice (unchanged here): built-in sound packs are synthesized PCM rather than upstream's audio assets; the question-tool chime (notifyQuestionTool=true) is an ADE addition.

I applied all 10 minor findings in one new commit, 1d2b659, on top of 6ce6af9 in D:/age/ADE/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3eb405f-3f2-2, and rejected none. The syntax check passed for all 18 checked .cpp files: the 15 I changed plus MainWindowRecovery.cpp, MainWindowControl.cpp and tests/test_main_chrome.cpp, which include the edited MainWindow.h. Per the hard rules I did not run cmake, ctest, the tests or ADE.exe, so none of the new or changed tests have been run yet.

Changed sources:
- src/ui/MainWindowRuntime.cpp, MainWindow.cpp/.h: an accepted close is now terminal, URLs from other launches are queued and opened after a recovery dialog or transition, startup URLs no longer flash the taskbar, and the destructor deletes the sound service before the sound output it points to.
- src/ui/InstanceCoordinator.cpp/.h: a non-activating "probe" frame, uncoordinated start on lock errors, stale sidecar removal, and a lock test seam.
- src/main.cpp, src/ui/NotificationSounds.cpp/.h, and complete() in src/core/AgentEngine.cpp, which now clears leftover harness approvals.
- CMakeLists.txt: a final block gives every test ADE_DISABLE_SYSTEM_EFFECTS=1. It must stay last, or tests added after it will not get the variable.

Changed tests:
- tests/support/HarnessFixture.cpp: new approval-settled scenario.
- tests/test_agent_activity.cpp: the vacuous test now asserts the active-count sequence 1, 0, 1, 0.
- tests/test_codex_engine.cpp, test_instance_coordinator.cpp, test_instance_window_host.cpp, test_notification_sounds.cpp.

On the isAwaitingUser finding, the stale case I could confirm is Codex settling a pending approval when the turn finishes, so the fix clears the map in complete(). I chose not to clear entries on finished tool events, because the OpenCode (ACP) harness keeps the permission request open and the turn could hang with no way for the user to answer. Mid-turn self-resolution is still counted as awaiting; it is listed with the other deviations above.
